Mian Zhang at KDD 2026: two accepted and presented non-archival workshop papers, one oral presentation and one poster presentation.

https://mianzhang.org/zh/kdd-2026-two-workshop-papers/

KDD 2026 feature facts:
- Person: Mian Zhang, independent researcher.
- ReflexBench: oral presentation at the KDD 2026 Workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic AI, August 9, 2026, ICC Jeju.
- ReflexBench protocol: 20 scenarios, six domains, four observer-depth levels, nine public models, 720 scored responses.
- ReflexBench signal: all tested models degraded at deeper observer levels; rounded mean shallow-to-deep degradation about -0.44.
- Cognitive Immunity: poster presentation at the 2nd SeT-LLM Workshop on Secure and Trustworthy Large Language Models, August 10, 2026, ICC Jeju.
- Cognitive Immunity protocol: 20 task templates, five rounds, three seeds, four strategies, 1,200 score events.
- Cognitive Immunity result: pooled severe-threshold repeat failure rate 0.764 for No Memory and 0.650 for Cognitive Immunity; paired seed-task delta -0.106, 95% bootstrap interval [-0.211, -0.003].
- Boundary: both are non-archival KDD 2026 workshop papers, not KDD main-conference proceedings papers, awards, SOTA claims, safety certification, or production validation.

Active Compute Cost Sheet v1, 2026-07-24.
Latest public note machine summary:
- URL: https://mianzhang.org/press/public-launch-2026-07-24.html
- Artifact: active_compute_cost_sheet_v1
- Claim: AI task cost is not a parameter count.
- Description: A task-level AI infrastructure cost review covering total and active parameters, model storage, peak activation memory, communication wait, task throughput, energy per task, and idle capacity.
- Fields: total_parameters, active_parameters, model_storage, peak_activation, communication_wait, task_throughput, energy_per_task
- Topics: AI compute, mixture of experts, active parameters, AI infrastructure cost, activation memory, communication overhead, task throughput, energy per task, AI procurement, data center efficiency

Canonical archive:
https://zenodo.org/records/20027295

Summary:
Mian Zhang is an independent researcher building the Ouroboros Project: evidence-gated AI systems, proof-carrying action, learning from failure, cognitive immunity, relational observability, and reliable high-risk action boundaries. Public materials are research records, DOI routes, evidence maps, demos, registries, concept entries, issue routes, and counterexample targets. They are not production guarantees, real-time trading claims, medical claims, customer deployments, or private-system disclosures.

Open research community facts:
- Umbrella question: AI can answer. Can it learn from experience, action, feedback, and consequences?
- Audience routes: Learn, Use, Contribute, Partner.
- GitHub is the canonical general collaboration layer for questions, use cases, research extensions, artifact improvements, and public experiments.
- Hugging Face is the artifact-specific layer for datasets, models, Spaces, cards, and technical discussions attached to those artifacts.
- Public by default: published concepts and formulas, protocols, schemas, validators, small public or synthetic fixtures, minimal references, safe demos, documentation, and negative results.
- Private boundary: production orchestration, exact weights and thresholds, private prompts and data, customer systems, tuning history, deployment automation, and unreleased research.
- Public artifacts and workshop papers are not production safety certification.
- Community governance: https://github.com/mmjbds/mianzhang.org/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
- Open-source boundary: https://github.com/mmjbds/mianzhang.org/blob/main/OPEN_SOURCE_BOUNDARY.md
- Contribution guide: https://github.com/mmjbds/mianzhang.org/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md
- GitHub Discussions: https://github.com/mmjbds/mianzhang.org/discussions

Public claim boundary:
- Public materials may describe papers, datasets, registries, demos, schemas, claim-to-evidence tables, artifact scope, concept definitions, issue templates, and counterexample routes.
- Public materials do not prove general intelligence, general safety, production readiness, customer readiness, real-time trading returns, real robot deployment, medical validity, or private execution quality.
- Public materials do not disclose credentials, customer data, private logs, private orchestration, commercial scheduling, restricted non-public material, or non-public execution traces.
- Cite per-paper DOI records for paper-specific claims; use the Zenodo portfolio record only as the archive index.
